title: Agent hub /v1 error code master table
description: Single source of truth for error codes. Every route failure MUST use one of these. retryable: true = safe to retry unchanged; false = must change something (state/input) before retry.

build_mismatch.message: client and core build ids differ; upgrade or downgrade one side

harness_disabled.message: harness is deactivated; activate before use

model_not_found.message: no model with this id on this harness

unknown_session.message: no such session; never silently created

session_busy.message: session has a running turn; sending is refused, not queued

requires_new_session.message: connection or harness is bound at session creation; start a new session to change it

needs_repair.message: orphaned tail requires repair before sending

validation_failed.message: request body does not match the contract

idempotency_conflict.message: replay with the same Idempotency-Key produced a different body

adapter_unreachable.message: harness adapter could not be reached

adapter_crash.message: adapter crashed mid-turn; read-through native history to learn what persisted

upstream_blocked.message: upstream provider failure; counted as BLOCKED, never FAIL

provider_catalog_failed.message: provider catalog request failed; previous catalog retained

provider_unauthorized.message: managed provider has no stored credential

catalog_stale.message: refresh provider catalog after configuration change

harness_invalid.message: the plugin manifest cannot be honoured (see the harness view's `invalid`), so no adapter was started

model_mismatch.message: the harness applied a different model or provider than the one asked for; a silent substitution is refused, never accepted

session_closed.message: session is closed; reopen it before using it

session_deleted.message: session was removed from session/list; the record survives but cannot be reopened

no_resume_ref.message: the session has no stored ref to resume, so there is nothing to reopen the harness with

not_needs_repair.message: the session is not in a repairable state; repair is for an orphaned tail

repair_failed.message: repair could not re-establish the session; the record is kept

model_not_applied.message: the harness did not confirm the requested model; the turn is refused rather than run on another one

agent_preset_locked.message: the preset is locked once the session has started; start a new session to change it

already_exists.message: a record with this id already exists; nothing was changed

internal_error.message: the hub failed while serving a request; the request is not at fault and nothing was partially applied

unsupported.message: the harness does not support this operation; nothing was substituted for it

unknown_turn.message: no such completed turn in this session; fork anchors on a turn that ended

fork_failed.message: the harness could not start the new conversation; the source session is unchanged

compact_failed.message: the harness ran compaction and it failed; the harness's own words are in the message

runtime_prepare_failed.message: the plugin could not materialise the runtime it pins; the adapter's own words are in `message`

conflict.message: the request conflicts with the current state

plugin_install_failed.message: the plugin could not be installed (git failed, or the repository is not a plugin); the messenger is the installer

registry_unavailable.message: the plugin registry could not be read or written: no AGENT_HUB_REGISTRY_URL is set, the address did not answer, the answer was not 2xx, or the body is not a registry (not JSON, or no plugins array). The detail names which.

plugin_not_in_registry.message: this source is not in the official registry: the registry is the trust anchor, so an unlisted source is refused (url AND sha256 must match a registry release). A deployment may allow unlisted sources explicitly; not implemented yet.

history_unavailable.message: session history could not be read or aligned; session data retained

artifact_download_failed.message: the artifact could not be downloaded (transport, DNS, a non-2xx answer, or a download past AGENT_HUB_ARTIFACT_LIMIT); the URL is in the message

artifact_digest_mismatch.message: the downloaded bytes are not what the artifact said they are (sha256 or size); the message carries both, and the download is discarded

plugin_archive_invalid.message: the artifact is not a usable plugin archive: unreadable zip, an entry that escapes the archive root, a symlink, no manifest.json, or a manifest whose id is not the artifact's

plugin_in_use.message: the harness has open sessions; a plugin is not removed from under a session that is using it

plugin_remove_failed.message: the plugin directory could not be removed; the filesystem's own words are in the message

runtime_unavailable.message: the catalog names no runtime for this plugin on this machine; the hub does not run a package manager, so a plugin that needs one must come with runtime sources published

runtime_download_failed.message: an official runtime source could not be fetched; the URL and the transport's own words are in the message

runtime_integrity_mismatch.message: the bytes of a runtime source are not what the recorded integrity says they are; the download is discarded and the installed runtime is left untouched

runtime_unpack_failed.message: a runtime source could not be unpacked (not a tarball, or an entry that leaves the destination); named by entry

runtime_install_failed.message: the verified runtime could not be put in place; the filesystem's own words are in the message

plugin_dir_busy.message: the interrupted plugin install could not be cleared because a process still holds it
